name: MALBEK
full_name: MAJORANA Low-background BEGe detector at Kimballton
summary: MALBEK was a low-background broad-energy germanium detector developed within MAJORANA R&D, carrying out low-threshold WIMP searches at the Kimballton facility.
detection_principle: Low-noise germanium ionization is measured, while pulse differences between surface and bulk events are studied to control low-energy backgrounds near the sub-keV range.

results.summary: R&D detector data support a WIMP search and studies of low-energy surface backgrounds.

science_scope: This record covers experiments that directly measure possible interactions between dark matter and ordinary matter. Published exclusion limits, background events and projected sensitivities do not constitute a dark-matter discovery.
